newsitem.title: USA: Mercury Air Group take stake in Patriot Aviation.
newsitem.headline: Mercury Air Group take stake in Patriot Aviation.

text.p: Mercury Air Group, Inc has taken a minority stake Patriot Aviation Services, Inc., it said in a statement.

Patriot, a certified Federal Aviation Administration(FAA) repair station, provides a wide range of aircraft maintenance, overhaul, painting and related technical services including the conversion of passenger aircraft to freighters at its Roswell, New Mexico Headquarters. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
